title: Assignment
description: One assignment, portfolio of customers or internal project, under one employment.

id.description: Stable id. Equal to the file name without .md. Never changed or reused.

kind.description: client: work for one customer. portfolio: ongoing work for several customers. internal: for the employer itself, open source and the like.

employment.description: Id of the employment this assignment was done under.

customer.description: The customer's real name. Empty for internal work.

customers.description: For a portfolio: every customer in it.

customer_public.description: Whether the customer may be named outside the profile: public, anonymised (use the alias), nda (ask before mentioning at all), unknown (treat as anonymised and ask).

customer_alias.description: How to describe the customer when it may not be named, e.g. 'a Norwegian public transport company'.

role.description: The owner's role on the assignment, as they describe it.

role_en.description: Vetted English version of role, when the profile is not in English.

start.description: First month, YYYY-MM (YYYY when the month is not known).

breaks.description: Periods inside start-end when the owner was away, YYYY-MM/YYYY-MM (both months included).

allocation.description: Share of full time, in percent. Empty when not known.

team_size.description: Number of people on the team, the owner included. Empty when not known.

tech.description: Technologies the owner used in practice on this assignment, by canonical name (tech-names.txt).

methods.description: Methods and practices, e.g. GitOps, Scrum.

sources.description: Where the facts come from, as labels (never paths): 'interview 2026-05-13', 'intake:old-cv.pdf', 'linkedin', 'self-edit 2026-10-20'.

confidence.description: How sure the facts are: verified (the owner checked this entry), stated (the owner said it), old-cv, linkedin, needs-confirmation. Empty means not assessed.

last_reviewed.description: Date the entry was last checked or changed (YYYY-MM-DD).

removed_reason.description: Why the entry was removed, in the owner's words.
